en_title: Death Stranding Movie Gets Update as Director Scouts Beautiful Filming Locations in Iceland
cn_title: 《死亡搁浅》电影导演赴冰岛勘景
subtitle: 风景如同游戏世界
opus_summary: 《死亡搁浅》电影导演迈克尔·萨诺斯基正在冰岛勘景，影片计划明年在冰岛和北爱尔兰拍摄。电影将讲述游戏世界中的原创故事，小岛秀夫参与制作；上映日期和演员阵容尚未公布。

paragraphs.en: The Death Stranding movie appears to be ramping up to production, as director Michael Sarnoski and cinematographer Pat Scola recently shared a beautiful view from location scouting.
paragraphs.cn: 《死亡搁浅》电影似乎正加紧推进制作：导演迈克尔·萨诺斯基和摄影指导Pat Scola近日分享了勘景时拍下的美丽风光。

paragraphs.en: Death Stranding director Michael Sarnoski is currently in Iceland scouting for locations that can be used for the film. He shared a selfie of himself wearing a Death Stranding T-shirt and also reposted a video from his cinematographer, Pat Scola, showcasing gorgeous Icelandic scenery featuring waterfalls and plenty of moss. It is a pretty breathtaking view, and one that perfectly replicates the kind of landscape you'd find in Death Stranding, albeit with a bit more sun.
paragraphs.cn: 《死亡搁浅》电影导演迈克尔·萨诺斯基目前正在冰岛寻找合适的拍摄地点。他分享了一张身穿《死亡搁浅》T恤的自拍照，还转发了摄影指导Pat Scola拍摄的视频。视频中的冰岛风景十分壮丽，瀑布飞流而下，苔藓随处可见。这番景色令人叹为观止，几乎就是《死亡搁浅》里的地貌，只是阳光更充足一些。

paragraphs.en: Whether or not this exact location will be used in the film remains to be seen, but it does show that the creative team behind the film understands the game's aesthetic. It's also great to see that they're going to be shooting on location, instead of relying exclusively on soundstages and CG backdrops. Sarnoski revealed earlier this summer that he plans to shoot the Death Stranding film next year in Iceland and Northern Ireland .
paragraphs.cn: 电影最终是否会在这个具体地点取景还有待确认，但这段视频表明主创团队理解游戏的美学风格。看到他们打算实地拍摄，而不是完全依赖摄影棚和CG背景，也令人高兴。萨诺斯基今年夏天早些时候透露，他计划明年在冰岛和北爱尔兰拍摄《死亡搁浅》电影。

paragraphs.en: Director Michael Sarnoski is on a location scout in Iceland for the #DeathStranding film produced by A24 and Square Peg https://t.co/Exx1PVCriv https://t.co/L9uDCxjOIm
paragraphs.cn: 导演迈克尔·萨诺斯基正在冰岛为A24和Square Peg制作的《死亡搁浅》电影勘景。

paragraphs.en: Sarnoski's Death Stranding will be a new, original story set within the world of the game. It has the full backing and involvement of series creator Hideo Kojima and will be produced in conjunction with A24. As a result, you can expect a new cast of characters, but Sarnoski has teased that familiar faces from the games may appear, as well . The film also comes at an interesting time, as Kojima has said he's uninterested in helming a third Death Stranding game , but would let someone else make it based on a concept he created. He's finding other ways to flesh out the world through both this film and other media, including an anime.
paragraphs.cn: 萨诺斯基执导的《死亡搁浅》电影将讲述发生在游戏世界中的全新原创故事。系列创作者小岛秀夫全力支持并参与其中，影片也将与A24合作制作。因此，观众可以期待一批新角色，不过萨诺斯基也暗示，游戏中的熟面孔或许会登场。这部电影出现的时机也颇有意思：小岛秀夫曾表示，他无意亲自制作第三部《死亡搁浅》游戏，但愿意让其他人根据他提出的构想来制作。他也在通过这部电影及动画等其他媒介，以不同方式充实《死亡搁浅》的世界。

paragraphs.en: There's currently no release date for the Death Stranding film, but a 2028 release date may not be out of the question depending on when it starts shooting next year. Cast details are also currently under wraps, but with production ramping up, we will presumably hear more on that front soon. Norman Reedus has already expressed interest in reprising his role as Sam Porter Bridges in the film , but his involvement has yet to be announced.
paragraphs.cn: 《死亡搁浅》电影目前尚未公布上映日期，但能否在2028年上映，或许要看明年何时开拍。演员阵容也仍未公开，不过随着制作工作加紧推进，我们大概很快就会听到更多消息。Norman Reedus此前已表示有兴趣在电影中继续饰演山姆·波特·布里吉斯，但官方尚未宣布他是否会参演。
